entities.summary: Mexico is a sovereign nation in North America, Americas. Its capital is Mexico City. Official languages include Spanish (de facto; no official at federal level). Government: Federal presidential constitutional republic. Population: approximately 131.5 million. Area: 1,964,375 km². Comprehensive index for Mexico covering Olmec (mother culture), Teotihuacán, Maya (Palenque, Chichén Itzá), Zapotec/Mixtec (Monte Albán), Toltec, Aztec/Mexica (Tenochtitlán, largest city in Americas), Cortés conquest 1519-21, New Spain viceroyalty (300 years), Hidalgo Grito 1810, independence 1821, Mexican-American War (lost half territory), Juarez/Reform War, Maximilian/French intervention, Porfirio Díaz Porfiriato, Mexican Revolution 1910-20, PRI 71-year rule, NAFTA, drug war 2006-present, and AMLO/Sheinbaum.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Mexico's Aztec/Mexica civilization was the largest city in the Americas at Tenochtitlán and its conquest by Cortés in 1519-21 had a profound impact on global history, leading to the transfer of vast wealth and knowledge from the New World to Europe. This event marked the beginning of European colonization in the Americas.
